question.html:
The unified atomic mass unit is defined as:

  1. of the mass of an unbound, neutral carbon-12 nucleus in its nuclear and electronic ground state at rest.
  2. of the mass of an unbound, neutral oxygen-16 nucleus in its nuclear and electronic ground state at rest.
  3. of the mass of an unbound, neutral carbon-12 atom in its nuclear and electronic ground state at rest.
  4. of the mass of an unbound, neutral oxygen-16 atom in its nuclear and electronic ground state at rest.
